themePresets.description: A playful comic house: warm cream paper, a rounded comic typeface, fat dark "sticker" outlines around bright crayon-coloured bars, wedges and dots, rounded corners, chunky round-capped lines, and a soft dashed grid.
themePresets.label: Cartoon

themePresets.description: Embedded web chart: narrow column, plain headline and deck, a rule under the footer.
themePresets.label: Datawrapper

themePresets.description: Print weekly: compact, flat headline over a deck that names the measure, units repeated down the ruler.
themePresets.label: The Economist

themePresets.description: Consulting deck: wide bands, every value printed in a column, a headline that states the takeaway.
themePresets.label: McKinsey

themePresets.description: Journal figure: small panel, axis titles kept with units, statistics printed beside the fit.
themePresets.label: Nature

themePresets.description: Newsroom graphics: a headline that states the finding, values printed on the marks, series named at their own ends.
themePresets.label: New York Times

themePresets.description: A pop-art remix of Swiss: electric process colours, heavy black structure, oversized marks, and punchy display type.
themePresets.label: Pop

themePresets.description: Dashboard tile: compact, legend to the right, the latest point emphasised.
themePresets.label: Power BI

themePresets.description: Light dashboard tile: white canvas, Segoe UI, hairline grid, legend to the right.
themePresets.label: Power BI (light)

themePresets.description: International Typographic Style: warm paper, a visible modular grid, black structural axes, a bold flush-left Helvetica headline over a rule, and a single signal-red accent.
themePresets.label: Swiss
